cat > scratch/logsum.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# logsum.sh: summarise a log file by level and by host
set -euo pipefail

usage() { echo "usage: $0 LOGFILE" >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$#" -eq 1 ] || usage
log=$1
[ -r "$log" ] || { echo "error: cannot read $log" >&2; exit 2; }

echo "== $log =="
echo "lines: $(wc -l < "$log")"
echo "by level:"
awk '{print $3}' "$log" | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | sed 's/^/  /'
echo "errors by host:"
grep ' ERROR ' "$log" | grep -o 'host=[a-z0-9]*' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | sed 's/^/  /'
EOF
chmod +x scratch/logsum.sh
